query_analysis.original_query: Our rotary drum filter is experiencing inconsistent cake formation. How can we develop a robust control strategy to maintain consistent filtration performance across varying slurry characteristics?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a robust control strategy for our rotary drum filter to maintain consistent filtration performance and cake formation despite varying slurry characteristics by identifying key process variables and implementing appropriate control measures.

selected_agents.role: Analyze filtration process and slurry characteristics
Identify causes of inconsistent cake formation

communication_strategy.information_flow: Exchange data on process variables and slurry characteristics to develop control strategies
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative analysis and design refinement integrating process control and filtration insights

clarification_questions: Can you provide details on the specific variations in slurry characteristics?
What are the current operating parameters of the rotary drum filter?
Have any control strategies been previously implemented or tested?
